cash_only_annual_baseline.assumptions: No interest, account costs or external cash flows

limitations: Explicit historical sensitivity assumption, not verified contemporaneous fees. Aggregate integer order notional and quadratic fee are rounded against the account to cents; no per-contract P&L scaling.

Candle endpoints have neither contemporaneous receipt nor depth proof. Hypothetical mode caps each order at100 contracts, freezes quantity/limit before later prices, and rejects missing endpoints. This arbitrary capacity ceiling is a sensitivity assumption, not historical liquidity. Verified mode must refuse unproven availability/depth.

Score only the existing unsealed daily-market panel through September30,2025. Annual ending trading bankroll must be null until the entire requested calendar is acquired and evaluated under a separately frozen continuation. Missing months are never silently imputed as no-trade days. Cash-only baseline for the whole365days is200 with zero interest, zero external cash flows and no trading fees.
October-December2025 stays sealed. This registration does not authorize reading protected prices/outcomes. No alteration of config/validation.json or promotion gates.

Retain every candidate, selected cash/trade result, excluded orders, reserved cash, open principal, cost-basis versus zero-mark equity, integer quantities, fees and missing calendar dates. No probability-of-ruin or100x target forecast from an unvalidated edge.
The September2025 panel was already examined in earlier development research; this is not an untouched evaluation.
The bootstrap is a within-batch selection diagnostic. It does not undo previous search or satisfy global final/forward promotion gates.
Same-time ordering is a deterministic portfolio convention; absent historical exchange priority, it is an additional execution assumption.

account.cost_marking: Cash plus cancellable order reservations plus open purchase principal; fees expensed immediately. This is bookkeeping at cost, not liquidation equity.
account.conservative_marking: Cash plus cancellable reservations; all unresolved held contracts marked zero, irrespective of known future labels.
account.startup: Starts flat; decisions before start are excluded, with no inherited positions or orders.
account.same_timestamp_order: Releases, then decisions ordered by trade_id, then entries ordered by trade_id.
account.fee_assumption: Supplied quadratic coefficients; one aggregate fill per entry/exit, account rounding applied to total debit/credit. No historical fee claim is inferred.
